historical_lineage.summary: 50% TSMOM_MAJORS + 50% CS_SKIP_MOM over rolling 30d Top-15 liquid Hyperliquid majors at VT=0.25, GP=0.88. Suffered live Testnet drag from 25bps GTC taker fallback (-$92.89 on 467 taker fills vs +$16.07 on 1,533 maker fills), 8.7% margin utilization, and static 50% TSMOM weight in chop (Fold 3 SR=0.141).

experiments.hypothesis: Gating multi-horizon (3.5d/7d/14d/30d) TSMOM by causal 14-day Kaufman Efficiency Ratio (ER_14d) damps sideways chop whipsaws while preserving clean breakout trends.
experiments.notes: Reduced OOS MaxDD from 9.06% to 8.01% and nearly tripled Fold 3 chop Sharpe (0.141 -> 0.402).

experiments.hypothesis: Adding explicit +12% 24H idiosyncratic mean-reversion sleeve inside CS_SKIP_MOM captures short-horizon overextensions.
experiments.notes: Skipping the last 24H in momentum is already optimal; explicitly betting on 24H reversion at 4H cadence fights multi-day institutional altcoin cascades and increases turnover (0.291 -> 0.317x/day) and MaxDD (9.06% -> 10.91%).

experiments.hypothesis: Confirming cross-sectional momentum with Frog-in-the-Pan (FIP_14d) path continuity and 3d/14d USD dollar-volume participation acceleration filters thin fakeouts.
experiments.notes: Improved full-sample Sharpe (2.541 -> 2.564) and Fold 1/Fold 2 Sharpe at modest 5%+5% ensemble weight.

experiments.hypothesis: Vetoing negative-funding longs in CS_SKIP_MOM avoids toxic breakdown traps.
experiments.notes: Critical empirical discovery: in Top-15 Majors, high 7d+14d residual momentum paired with negative funding represents a lucrative crowded-short squeeze, NOT a falling knife. Vetoing it destroyed +0.26 OOS Sharpe.

experiments.hypothesis: 4H perpetual-vs-oracle premium mean-reversion adds orthogonal basis alpha.
experiments.notes: Perp-oracle premium dislocations revert at sub-5-minute HFT horizons; fading them on a 4H bar enters against informed trend initiation.

experiments.hypothesis: Including ETH inside CS_SKIP_MOM and adding 30d skip-24h residual momentum improves Fold 2/3 dispersion.
experiments.notes: Boosted Fold 2 SR to 4.531 and Fold 3 SR to 0.537 with lower MaxDD (8.39%), but hurt Fold 1 (SR 0.142). Retained for future shadow testing.
